identity.rule: A locked VAL: chosen percentage <= 0.1 and native winner count > 0

evidence_boundary: R108 uses the original scratch R84/R88B full18 selector with 1,842,953 trainables. Both arms share the same complete fresh tensors, fixed TRAIN-only (problem, exactN) prior buffers, forward computation and original maximin inference on s=logpi+t. Active gradient freedom is not identical: CE common-shift gauge cancels the shared last-bias data gradient, whereas the ratio anchors the utility origin. t is the original learned utility. A trains pure CE(s); B trains the canonical product-noise binary ratio: half positive softplus(-t_y) plus half pi-weighted softplus(t). Its normalization differs from CE; no equal gradient-scale claim. The ratio sigmoid is not a champion probability. Training classification losses and evaluation maximin CE are different diagnostics and are not compared as equal losses. Single forward, dropout0.1; comparison/risk/KL/RDrop weights and RDrop ramp are zero. 57,600 updates, logical batch1024, seed2, AdamW1e-4 to1e-6. Prior tables are small frozen aggregate TRAIN-fit classifier parameters, not per-instance features or query labels. Priors alone do not demonstrate instance learning: the saved VAL/TEST t=0 reference is a TRAIN winner-frequency conditional prior, not a cost-optimal SBS. Model gains versus that reference are reported separately from gains versus SBS. No new feature cache, donor, additional path module, teacher, context labels, new targets, calibration, quota or auxiliary loss. R89A AdamW, R89B Muon and R84A are saved historical references, not rerun or newly parameter/FLOP-matched controls; R94B is optional, never a prerequisite. Fixed36 rescues, losses, false picks and aligned net costs/regret are separate from choice frequency. Native/FP64 ind and legal pools; TRAIN-fitted SBS; ALL task-equal. TEST is development-exposed; one whole-model full18 VAL checkpoint for full TRAIN/VAL/TEST/LIB; no TEST/LIB reselection. Actual standalone GPU-resident-input timing includes complete model prior lookup and residual computation, excludes dataset I/O, CPU transfer and solvers, and is not end-to-end dataset latency. No routing-summary requirement. No online W&B equality/availability is asserted.
